title: Numerically optimized amplitude-robust controlled-Z gate for ultracold neutral atoms with individual addressing capability
summary: We numerically optimized a scheme for a symmetric controlled-Z (CZ) gate based on the Rydberg blockade in neutral atoms, with the aim of increasing its robustness to variations in the Rabi frequency. The scheme exploits analytically defined phase profiles of the laser pulse and proves almost an order of magnitude more robust to Rabi-frequency variations than previously proposed protocols.
